## Skills
### Practice: agents & LLM
- Agentic workflow: spec → plan → task → review → audit, one commit per task; rules, skills and hooks shared by every agent, wired to MCP tools for browser and IDE checks. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, opencode. See [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/netoun/netoun.github.io/blob/main/AGENTS.md)
- Tool-calling LLM pipelines: subagents call tools and return schema-validated output, turning 100+ page PDFs into structured data; every quoted piece of evidence is checked against the source text (AI SDK, zod, queues, OCR; client work, not listed; Cuevr)
- LLM evaluation: ground-truth datasets, field-level accuracy weighted by criticality, prompt and model comparison, replay of past runs (client work, not listed)
- LLMOps: prompts versioned in git and promoted from development to production, every step traced (Langfuse, OpenTelemetry, Sentry; client work, not listed)

## Labs
Interactive CSS 3D, canvas and shader experiments, each live with its source code, a `man` page and an xray view of its mechanism.
- [3D Computer](https://www.netoun.com/labs/computer-3d/): A retro computer workstation built entirely with CSS 3D transforms — no WebGL, just perspective and transform-style: preserve-3d.
- [3D Server Rack](https://www.netoun.com/labs/server-unit-3d/): A stacked server rack in CSS 3D with deterministic, seed-driven status LEDs — resize it, reseed it, spin it around.
- [Chrome Capture](https://www.netoun.com/labs/chrome-capture/): The polished chrome bezel the process monitor and the Labs index set their captures in — a conic-gradient bezel and a glint that follow the pointer, in CSS.
- [Glitch Signal Map](https://www.netoun.com/labs/glitch-signal-map/): A Canvas 2D signal grid with a per-cell state machine, pulsing accents and glitchy recalibration — throttled to 30fps.
- [Cybernetic Glyph Grid](https://www.netoun.com/labs/cybernetic-glyph-grid/): A Canvas 2D grid of hex pairs and glitch glyphs that pulse, flicker and re-randomize on a deterministic timer.
- [Fake Console](https://www.netoun.com/labs/fake-console/): A log reel that rolls in one seeded line every 500 ms — ten LCG draws a line, the DOM written by hand, no React render per line.
- [System Metrics Panel](https://www.netoun.com/labs/system-metrics/): A telemetry HUD whose six meters wander ±1 a tick on fixed drift sequences — no random numbers, a pure function of the tick.
- [Film Grain Shader](https://www.netoun.com/labs/grain-shader/): The paper's film grain — one signed hash per physical pixel — drawn live in WebGL beside the 128 px tile the site bakes from the same function.
- [Mesh Gradient](https://www.netoun.com/labs/mesh-background/): An animated mesh-gradient background: three drifting colour blobs, a vignette and optional film grain, all in one fragment shader.
- [Scroll Morph](https://www.netoun.com/labs/scroll-morph/): The hero's frame closing in on the content column as the page scrolls — one clip-path keyframe on a scroll timeline, no scroll listener.
- [Split-Flap Board](https://www.netoun.com/labs/split-flap/): A departure board in CSS 3D: every flap turns forward through its drum until it lands on its letter, four half-cards and two hinged leaves per character.
- [Patch Bay](https://www.netoun.com/labs/patch-bay/): Three patch cables that hang, swing and replug: Verlet points under gravity, held together by distance constraints and drawn as one smoothed SVG path each.
- [ASCII Raymarcher](https://www.netoun.com/labs/ascii-raymarcher/): A signed-distance scene raymarched once per character cell and printed as real text: each cell's brightness picks a Doto glyph from a ramp.
